_comment: Source of truth for generated LVGL fonts. Run: platformio run -t fonts (see README 'Fonts'). Font files are downloaded into cache_dir (gitignored); only the generated .c files are committed.

inter._comment: Google Fonts Inter variable font. Pick an instance per font with 'variations' (opsz 32 = Inter Display).

fonts._comment: Alarm overlay digits and the weather-page temperature: 0-9, ':', '-', degree sign, minus.
fonts.name: inter_48

fonts._comment: Body/status text (HG_FONT_STATUS) and LVGL's default font. Printable ASCII, Latin-1 (includes the degree sign), plus typographic punctuation: en/em dash, curly quotes, bullet, ellipsis, minus.
fonts.name: inter_14

fonts._comment: Headings and the alarm time (HG_FONT_ALARM). Same glyph set as inter_14.
fonts.name: inter_28
